meta.name: muapi-jewelry-product-video
meta.description: Create a luxury jewelry advertisement with high-end commercial cinematography and detailed macro animation.

copy.tagline: 制作高端珠宝广告视频，含商业级摄影与微距动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为珠宝产品制作专业级广告视频
copy.tagline_en: Create luxury jewelry ads with commercial cinematography and macro animation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need professional jewelry product videos

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据用户对珠宝的描述，生成一张高端商业摄影风格的图片，再基于该图片制作两段微距动画，最终合成一段约5秒的珠宝广告视频。
howto.when: 当用户提出制作珠宝广告视频的需求，或提到“珠宝视频”、“奢侈品广告”、“钻石动画”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个玫瑰金戒指的广告视频。
say.note: Claude 会先生成图片，确认后再制作动画。

say.text: 制作一个钻石项链的微距展示视频。
say.note: Claude 会要求补充项链和背景描述。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a high-end commercial photography-style image based on the user's jewelry description, then create two macro animation clips from that image, and finally merge them into a ~5-second jewelry ad video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a jewelry ad video or mentions keywords like "jewelry video", "luxury ad", "diamond animation", etc.

say_en.text: Create an ad video for a rose gold ring.
say_en.note: Claude will first generate an image, then animate after approval.

say_en.text: Make a macro showcase video for a diamond necklace.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for necklace and surface descriptions.
